document_title: Process Characterization Master Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Master plan spans the whole train; entities are the Step 3-10 process steps and the CQA framework.
The per-unit-operation plan register and the common statistical approach are reported via report_sections.
Strictly prospective: the plan carries no characterization results, and it deliberately sets no campaign-wide minimum capability index, so no capability or classification entity is asserted here.

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 states once the quality attribute framework, the risk basis, the scale-down approach, the statistical methods and the acceptance framework that are common to every per-unit-operation plan of the campaign.

source_references.quote: are common to all of them, and this plan states them once

statements.statement_text: RA-001 ranks every parameter on its potential impact on a quality attribute and on its potential to interact, and assigns it a study type.

source_references.quote: RA-001 ranks every parameter carried into the assessment on its potential impact on a quality attribute and on its potential to interact with other parameters, and assigns it a study type

statements.statement_text: Parameters that can affect an attribute and can interact are studied together in a multivariate design; those that act independently are studied one at a time.

source_references.quote: Parameters that can affect an attribute and can interact are studied together in a multivariate design

statements.statement_text: Screening identifies which factors act and where the interactions are, and the response surface model is the predictive model from which the operating region, the proven acceptable ranges and the capability estimate are all derived.

source_references.quote: The response surface model is the predictive model, and the operating region, the proven acceptable ranges and the capability estimate of the step are all derived from it

statements.statement_text: The master plan sets no single capability index as an acceptance criterion for the campaign.

source_references.quote: No single capability index is set as an acceptance criterion for this campaign

statements.statement_text: A response is judged against the in-process limit of its step where one has been established, and against the drug substance acceptance criterion where none has.

source_references.quote: The criterion a response is judged against is the in-process limit of the step where one has been established, and the drug substance acceptance criterion where none has

statements.statement_text: An in-process limit is generally the tighter of the two because it carries margin against the clearance the downstream steps must still deliver, so an operating region judged against it is smaller than one judged against the drug substance criterion.

source_references.quote: it is set with margin against the clearance the downstream steps must still deliver

statements.statement_text: A scale-down model is qualified for an attribute when the difference between scales is smaller than the variability of the method that measures it.

source_references.quote: A model is qualified for an attribute when the difference between scales is smaller than the variability of the method that measures it

statements.statement_text: Where a step needs a rule different from the campaign default, its own plan states the rule and the reason for it.

source_references.quote: Where a step needs a different rule, its plan will state the rule and the reason for it

statements.statement_text: Each per-unit-operation report classifies the parameters of its step, states the ranges it will be operated within, and names the in-process controls and release tests that hold the attributes the step forms or clears.

source_references.quote: Each report classifies the parameters of its step, states the ranges the step will be operated within, and names the in-process controls and the release tests that hold the attributes the step forms or clears

statements.statement_text: The campaign delivers eight characterization plans, eight characterization reports and one master report.

source_references.quote: The campaign delivers 8 characterization plans, 8 characterization reports and one master report
